title: The Stolen Chime Array
logline: A museum curator secretly sneaks the station's founding bronze chimes out of her own vault to return them to the descendants of exiled miners before security intercepts the shipment.

roles.description: The station cultural preservationist; quietly ashamed of sanitizing history, determined to return the bells to the strike families.
A blockade-running freight skipper contracted by the exile colony to receive the founding bells.
A swift militia interceptor enforcing the security cordon around the station's outer docks.
The station defense militia, tasked with recovering the founding bells for the official opening ceremonies.
A reinforced display pavilion on the concourse meant to showcase founding colonial heritage.
An unmonitored docking pylon in the outer debris ring where perimeter fuel lighters moor.

public_situation: The Centennial Founding Chimes have vanished from {role:curator_vault} on the eve of the festival, and {role:civic_guard} has sealed departure lanes.
private_truth: {role:festival_curator} removed the bells herself to return them to the descendants of the strike-exiled foundry workers before the council rings them on broadcast.

beats.public_change: {role:civic_guard} posts an armed perimeter around the station concourse, offering bounties for reports on the missing bronze chimes.

missions.reason: She needs an outside pilot to haul the secured chime array crates from the museum freight airlock out to the perimeter berth before morning muster.
missions.private_fact: She packed the founding bells herself and is delivering them to the descendants of the strike-exiled foundry workers.

beats.public_change: {role:civic_guard} launches {role:patrol_cutter} to sweep outer berths, threatening to scuttle vessels attempting to depart.

missions.reason: She needs the perimeter patrol cutter disabled before boarding teams breach the transport container and seize the founding bells.
missions.private_fact: The cutter captain hails offering to split the station recovery bounty if the pilot surrenders the bronze cases without firing.

beats.public_change: {role:exile_corsair} docks at {role:exile_berth} with an unshielded transport barge to receive the bells before jump gate transit.

missions.reason: She needs the chime container transferred directly to the exile freighter before station defense locks the outward jump gate.
missions.private_fact: The exile crew plans to tune sublight antenna horns to broadcast the chimes over system frequencies during official speeches.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot disables the cutter and delivers the bells to the exile crew.
resolutions.summary: The exiled miners ring the founding chimes over system frequencies during opening ceremonies. {role:festival_curator} resigns quietly, and the station council faces historic unrest.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot ran the militia cordon so the descendants of exiled miners could ring their founding bells.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the guard's reward or fails the delivery.
resolutions.summary: {role:civic_guard} recovers the bronze chime array and imprisons {role:festival_curator}. The founding bells ring on schedule for council dignitaries under heavy armed watch.

consequences.public_summary: Word is a pilot turned over the missing founding bells to station militia in exchange for a quiet payout.

resolutions.reached_by: The bells are diverted to black-market metal dealers.
resolutions.summary: The antique bronze bells are melted down into unmarked industrial ingots. {role:festival_curator} is ruined by the loss, and the festival opens in total silence across the concourse.

consequences.public_summary: Miners swear the station's founding bells ended up in a perimeter foundry crucible after an armed transfer went bad.

loose_threads.detail: The chime tubes bear foundry roll stamps matching the convict labour records of the first mining strike.
A municipal dock notice lists an unbilled berthing reservation under the name of an exile elder who died twenty years ago.
An exchange broker posted a high-tin bronze buying contract twelve hours before the vault alarm sounded.

radio_hooks: Station security announces reward for information on missing founding chimes.
Centennial festival preparations continue under reinforced perimeter guard.
Exile radio frequencies across {system} play antique foundry marching songs.

voice_direction.festival_curator: Uses guarded, minimal phrasing and avoids legal terminology. Pauses defensively whenever station militia patrols are mentioned.
voice_direction.exile_corsair: Brisk and impatient, cutting off pleasantries with technical docking jargon. Treats the hundred-year-old bronze bells like a family debt long past due.
